description: Get one exact model's full catalog row, including model_spec constraints, capabilities, and pricing when available. Requires a concrete type to keep the upstream catalog response bounded. No authentication required.

model_id.description: Exact model id, e.g. from venice_list_models({ type: "video" }).

type.description: Catalog type the model belongs to: text, image, inpaint, upscale, video, music, tts, asr, embedding, decision.

name: venice_model_details
title: Venice Model Details
